Based on the provided onboarding document, there is no mention of a standalone macOS `.app`/`.dmg` installer (`Hermes.app`) or this specific error. 

**Best Guess & Explanation:**
1. **Cause of the Error:** The error `zsh: bad CPU type in executable` occurs on macOS when you attempt to run a binary that was compiled exclusively for Apple Silicon (ARM64) on an Intel-based (x86_64) Mac. Intel processors cannot execute ARM64 binaries.
2. **Possible App Confusion or Setup Issue:** Hermes Agent (`NousResearch/hermes-agent`) is primarily a CLI/Python project rather than a packaged `.dmg`/`.app` installer. It is possible this installer is from a different tool named Hermes or is an ARM64-only prebuilt binary. To run Hermes Agent on an Intel Mac, you should install it via its standard Python/shell installation scripts or using the multi-arch Docker image (`linux/amd64`).
